verses.mystical_translation: The hidden voice moves a ruler’s heart; exile’s season turns toward home by a divine stirring.
A foreign crown hears a summons from heaven and is set as instrument to build.
A summons to join the rebuilding; allegiance and household gods stand as companion and warrant.
Those left behind are to be sustained by neighborly provision; the house takes shape with shared sacrifice.
Leadership and priestly lines answer the inward stirring; tasks follow a shared spirit.
Hands are strengthened with gifts—material support becomes sacred supply.
What was carried into foreign temples is now returned; sacred things resume their place.
An imperial treasurer returns counted relics into the care of a provincial prince.
The inventory names gold and silver, and a count that insists on detail; instruments of cult and meal alike speak of return.
Basins of gold and of silver number the ritual forms returned to place.
A single total holds the dispersed pieces together; the exile’s cargo becomes the city’s inheritance.

contemplative_note: Divine initiative acts through imperial power; reflect on displacement, material restoration, and who carries communal memory home.
